title: A Venezuelan Billionaire Just Shared The Details Behind Trump’s “Biggest Oil Deal In World History.” Here’s What It Means For A 68 Year Old With A $2.4M Portfolio Heavily Invested In Energy Stocks
summary: President Trump calls it the biggest oil deal in world history. The secret 50-year contract the Washington Post obtained gives taxpayers a 35% stake in Alejandro Betancourt's Venezuelan producer and 20% of its oil at $30 a barrel. At Tuesday's $91.49 Brent that discount is worth about $1 billion a year, $7.43 per household, and the stake pays no dividend until output more than quadruples. Here is what it means for gas prices and for a retiree holding Exxon, Chevron or an energy fund.
